definitions.explanation: Describing something that moves or progresses at a low speed. The opposite of {速|はや}い (hayai, fast).
Describing something that happens after the expected or scheduled time. Also used for late hours of the day/night.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遅|おそ}い⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: This bus is slow, isn't it?

examples.japanese: {遅|おそ}く⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧。
⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧{遅|おそ}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}しました→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I studied until late at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{遅|おそ}く⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遅|おそ}い⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This computer is slow, so I want a new one.

examples.japanese: {遅|おそ}い⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}して→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧。
examples.english: Sorry for calling at a late hour.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{遅|おそ}く⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please speak a little more slowly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{遅|おそ}く⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{遅|おそ}い⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{食|た}べています→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I eat slowly, so I'm always the last one eating.

notes:
{遅|おそ}い is an i-adjective with two main meanings: slow (speed) and late (time).

USAGE:
{遅|おそ}い covers both "slow" (of speed) and "late" (of time), with context disambiguating: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{遅|おそ}い can mean either "the train is slow" or "the train is late." It modifies a noun directly ({遅|おそ}い⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧, "a late hour") and forms the adverb {遅|おそ}く ("slowly; late"), as in {遅|おそ}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ ("to become late").

FORMS:
- Negative: {遅|おそ}くない
- Past: {遅|おそ}かった
- Adverb: {遅|おそ}く (slowly; late)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {遅|おそ}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become late, to be delayed
- {遅|おそ}くても: at the latest
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧{遅|おそ}く: late at night
- {遅|おそ}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until late

ANTONYMS:
- ⟦{速|はや}い→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧: fast (speed)
- ⟦{早|はや}い→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧: early (time)

Note: For speed, the opposite is ⟦{速|はや}い→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧. For time (late/early), the opposite is ⟦{早|はや}い→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧. Both are read はやい but use different kanji.
